description: Offline release preparation contracts and deterministic status cases.

approvedNotes: Add an offline token catalog to all five SDKs, covering 39 assets and 60 deployments on Ethereum, Solana, and Avalanche C-Chain.
Add shared asset and deployment lookups, chain and currency filters, address and symbol searches, alias constants, and lifecycle metadata backed by deterministic generated data.

invariants: strict stable semver rejects leading zeroes and prereleases
prepare requires a clean expected-head checkout and writes only the version/changelog allowlist
Cargo.lock permits changing only the unique source-less erpc-sdk package version
Unreleased notes are preserved; approved notes fill an empty Unreleased section
omitted dates and transport/raw hashes do not change semantic fingerprints
inspect is read-only unless an explicit report path is provided
dependency resolution, network access, commits, tags, and publication are never performed
